'''DecipherCon 1999 Allegiances''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher posted two four-player table sheets but no overall winner.<ref name="dc99sw10_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Allegiances Multi Deck Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525035447/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99sw10_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Allegiances Multi Deck Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031220355/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
